summary: The registrant, Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust, filed an 8-K reporting an amendment (No. 4) to its existing revolving credit facility. The amendment extends the borrowing availability period to October 15, 2027 and the maturity date to October 15, 2028. No new equity or debt issuance, no change in control or corporate structure, and no special situation catalyst is involved. The filing is a routine modification of a credit agreement without transformative corporate action.
